After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Octavio se recupera de las heridas causadas por el atentado, mientras en el pueblo nace el rumor de una guerra empieza en la zona. Al mismo tiempo, Olga llega al pueblo junto con su esposo, el cual ha cambiado, pues es machista y la maltrata. Por otra parte, Ricardo decide cancelar la boda con Esperanza debido al regreso de Esmeralda.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Después del asesinato de la hermana de Moreno en manos de Eduardo, Moreno planea la venganza. Mientras tanto, los caciques de las esmeraldas llegan a un acuerdo. En esos días, Esmeralda le cuenta a su hijo que Eduardo es su padre, ocasionado que la odie y decida irse a vivir con él.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo le enseña a Octavio a disparar. Días después, Ricardo se casa el mismo día del cumpleaños de Octavio, obviamente Eduardo acapara la plaza del pueblo, horas después, en la salida de la iglesia, la familia Guerrero es atacada por el bando de Moreno: hiriendo a Ricardo y llevándose a Eduardo y a Esmeralda como rehenes, en consecuencia, Eduardo es torturado mientras Esmeralda observa.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El Ejército llega para dar orden al pueblo, no obstante, cierran las minas de la región, por esto los Mineros y Reina son encerrados en la cárcel. Por otra parte, Esperanza se decepciona cuando Ricardo en coma repite el nombre de Esmeralda, ese mismo día, Esmeralda escapa y los hombres de Moreno son acribillados por el ejército de Eduardo.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: La intervención del ejército empeora la situación. Esmeralda y Ricardo se reconcilian, lo que despierta el rencor de Esperanza. Esa noche, Olga es golpeada por su celoso esposo. Luego, Eduardo finge querer reconciliarse, pero en realidad planea desenmascarar a Esmeralda y Ricardo, haciéndolos quedar mal ante los Guerrero.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo asesina a Moreno en la mitad del pueblo, detonante para que en el pueblo se forme una revuelta que se sale de control tras el cierre de las minas cerradas. Alcides se une con Eduardo, convirtiéndose en uno de sus lavaperros. Al mismo tiempo, Octavio cae en el vicio y la mala vida. Por esos días los obreros planean atacar a los Guerreros culpándolos de avaros.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Obreros roban en la casa de los Guerrero, pero Alejandro mata a uno y renuncia a la alcaldía. Esa noche descubre la verdad sobre la muerte de Ortega y el matrimonio forzado de Eduardo. Días después, cuando solo empresas privadas pueden licitar, comienzan alianzas en el pueblo, marcando un nuevo rumbo en la disputa por las minas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Alcides golpea a Olga y el Padre Javier lo enfrenta. Olga pide el divorcio y lo expulsa. Ese día, una explosión ilegal en la mina sepulta a obreros, y Eduardo ordena dejarlos enterrados. Además, excluye a “El Tigre” del negocio, generando su rencor.

programme.title: Impacto Solar (2024)
programme.desc: Cuando los desechos solares caen contra la Tierra provocando una devastación generalizada, la radiación solar resultante provoca mutaciones genéticas en todos los que entran en contacto. A medida que la radiactividad se propaga rápidamente, y con los gobiernos y militares de todo el mundo al borde del colapso, un grupo de amigos se une para huir del caos, desesperados y con la esperanza de encontrar refugio.

programme.title: Catástrofe helada (2024)
programme.desc: Es Navidad y todo está tranquilo en un apacible pueblo mientras la nieve cubre cada rincón. Sin embargo, la tragedia empieza cuando un terrorí­fico meteorito se estrella y amenaza con dejar cristalizada a toda la población.

programme.title: Laberinto de Sombras (2025)
programme.desc: Elena quedó ciega tras un accidente, y vive sola en una vieja casa familiar. Con la llegada de dos extraños que pretenden robarle sus joyas y la aparición de extrañas fuerzas sobrenaturales convertirán la casa en un peligroso laberinto.

programme.title: Matar o Morir (2024)
programme.desc: Cuando a Jack, un asesino a sueldo de Londres, se le devuelve la vida y se le da la oportunidad de salvar a su hija, se convierte en una carrera contra el tiempo para matar o ser asesinado.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade, Ryan and Bearcub take on the midwest! After some tough hunting, the group is able to make a move to get in position on a BIG midwestern gobbler! Bearcub was able to harvest him after working the bird for almost 45 minutes! Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: "Summer Farm Work, Deer Season is Coming!!"
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade puts in some early summer farm work to Ensure his target bucks are well fed! Slade also Talks about his Target buck for the year, "Pope"! Slade is laying the trap early in hopes "Pope" makes a mistake early!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they tag along side Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day! This is a great opportunity to learn from one of the best. We are blessed to be able to share his knowledge with other like minded outdoor enthusiasts.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: John Sewell has played a huge part in the development of feeding Fortified Cottonseed 365 days a year. Laramie Barrett of Fortified Cottonseed joins John for a great weekend of hunting at his ranch in Uvalde, Texas. This is a great time for Laramie to get away from the office and see the first hand of how their product is performing.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed today to hunt with Cole Dutton for the Inaugural Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. We are honored to spend a weekend with Cole and his family at the G2 Ranch. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, Jameson Redding is exploring St. Marks, Florida, along with his friend Chris Funk trying to catch a species of Bass that is unique to the area.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: We are in Marathon, the heart of the Florida Keys, where crystal-clear waters meet charming island vibes. Known for its pristine dive sites, rich marine life, and welcoming locals, Marathon offers some of the best underwater adventures in the world.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Can You Surf & Eat Like a Local in Minnesota? Wild Foraging & Delicious Local Eats"
programme.desc: In Episode 3, Josh starts off in the Twin Cities where he meets up with Yia Vang, an award-winning Hmong chef and restaurant owner, bringing his family’s traditions and flavors to the American Midwest. As Josh heads up north to Duluth and the boundary waters, he’ll meet plenty of farmers and foragers—harvesting mushrooms, wild rice, and catching a few fish (and waves) along the way. It all wraps up with an epic feast hosted by Yia back in the cities.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the sparsely populated country of Namibia, in southern Africa, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.sub-title: "Groups working to restore our vital ecosystems"
programme.desc: We highlight organizations and programs making a difference in the Florida Keys. Learn how they help protect and restore these vital ecosystems.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: "Lone Star Boating: Exploring Central Texas Lakes & Rivers"
programme.desc: In Episode 10 Boat Trader heads to central Texas to explore boating culture in the lone star state. Second only to Alaska in size, Texas is known as the place where everything is bigger. From big college football games to endless oil fields and vast wind farms, Texas is home to more than 30 million Americans. But the state is about more than just big oil, college football and cattle farms - it's also home to some of the best boating in the country. Boasting a myriad of waterways, boaters here enjoy hundreds of lakes, rivers and streams that provide recreational opportunities, abundant wildlife and plenty of fishing. From Austin Texas to San Antonio host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew explore the laid-back Texas lake life including boat up restaurants along the Colorado River, watersports in Austin and the history of the waterways throughout the region. Boat manufacturers highlighted in this episode are Tige Boats and ATX Surf Boats, two premium Texas-based wake boat brands known for their high-quality, cutting-edge vessels that come equipped with advanced wake shaping technologies and equipment ideal for water skiing, wake surfing and wakeboarding. There's even a wake surfing dog!

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Josh Calhoon takes Scott from Yo-Zuri out for a day on the water, with hopes of adding a few new species to his catch list.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Rochelles in Central Saskatchewan putting time in on an old old bully buck.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Are Dinosaurs Still Alive In The African Congo?"
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Killer Croc's Warning The True Story Of Brett Mann"
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct? - In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask: - When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Could Bull Sharks Survive In The Great Lakes"
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Jonah Wasn't Alone Modern People Swallowed By Whales"
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff explore the breathtaking Waipio Valley, the Hawaiian "Valley of the Kings," in search of prawns and bullfrogs. Their adventure continues up a massive volcano, hunting invasive rams, before ending with a feast of native fish paired with island fruits and spices.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, follow along as Mark Peterson sets out on his second attempt in British Columbia for a Stone Sheep with his Gunwerks muzzleloader. After dealing with terrible weather and not many sheep encounters on his first hunt, Mark is eager to fill his tag this time around. Traveling to some of the best areas for sheep, Mark and the crew have a spectacular week of sheep encounters along with multiple close calls that will tear you down and drive you crazy!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This week is all about Woody, a fearless Jack Russle who spends his free time doing everything from Black Bear hunting in Vancouver to Sheep hunting in the mountains.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along as Mark Peterson travels to Tanzania to hunt the Eastern and Western White-Bearded Wildebeest. These animals are known for their distinctive white beards and large horns, making them a sought-after trophy for hunters on an African safari. Mark sets out on an exciting and thrilling adventure to track down these elusive creatures in the plains of Tanzania.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Hunting Anatolian Chamois in Turkey With Mark Peterson"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Giant 15 Point Kansas Whitetail, Early Season Hunt"
programme.desc: It's 2016 and Mark heads down to Kansas for an early season Muzzleloader Whitetail hunt with Salt River Outfitters. It was hot in the stand with little deer movement until the moon phase switched and - one of the bucks Mark had been looking for stepped out. Kansas is one of those states that has an early Muzzleloader season that opens in September, and if you can get the weather and the moon to align you can catch a big deer on his feet in daylight.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: After coming back from their road trip to Illinois, Jerry is looking to hit the Pennsylvania woods again in search of a buck named Flyer. This is a buck that Jerry passed up last year that he knew held a ton of potential, and after he started getting pictures of him this year, he knew he made the right call. The only problem is that this buck is a traveler and very unpredictable and could be anywhere at anytime. So trying to be in the right spot at the right time proves to be difficult for Jerry.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure we travel to Colorado and hook up with an organization called "Angling with officers" and we jump in the boat with some courageous law enforcement officers from local departments. We also honor the Rapid City, SD SCHEELS Hometown Hero, David Pearcy!

programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Late October is one of the best times of the season to make a move, and Owen Reigler with Midwest Whitetail did just that on a great Iowa buck he calls the 6x6. programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Youth turkey season in Alabama is always special, but this one means a little bit more. programme.desc: Jamie’s rustling up lamb meatballs, chop salad, and harissa yogurt; plus an incredibly delicious chicken salad.

programme.title: Sugar Showdown
programme.desc: Bakers from East Aurora, New York, Vancouver, Canada and Manchester, New Hampshire compete in a speedy eliminaJon round with Mayonnaise as the mystery ingredient. The last two standing compete for $10,000 in an Alien-­‐themed Cupcake Showdown. With judges Zane Caplansky , Johnny Iuzzini and Sherry Yard.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: The series is off to an energetic start as Diana delves into the vibrant and healthy flavours of Vietnamese cooking. With the expertise of her flatmate Khanh Ong cooking their favorite dishes together. Diana is also joined in the kitchen by chef Jerry Mai who demonstrates how to make mini rice pancakes that are best served with freshly brewed Vietnamese beer, of course!

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Thai food is on the menu so Diana enlists the help of mentor and Thai food enthusiast, Gary Mehigan, who is an expert at striking the balance of salty, sweet and sour. She also explores the varieties of fresh Asian herbs at the market, before heading back to the kitchen to recreate a delicious dish she sampled on a recent trip.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: The home cooks go global with crowd-pleasers from around the world, and kelp has everyone reeling when they take a deep dive into Chef Todd Perrin’s fridge.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie kicks things off this week by cooking up his Super-Fast Sizzling Seared Scallops with a cool hack for speedy spuds. Then there’s egg and mango chutney flatbreads, a snack for when you’re in a hurry with the fastest bread you’ll ever make.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: Silvia starts with the basics. How do Italian home cooks shop for pantry staples and fresh produce? A guided visit to an Italian deli leads to shopping and preparing of: a rustic Tuscan chickpea pasta, bakes 2 succulent and savoury Schiacciata breads and Silvia's mothers Apple and Mascarpone cake. Proving that when an Italian pantry is well stocked you only need a few fresh ingredients to create simple yet memorable meals

programme.title: Evolving Vegan
programme.desc: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in elevated plant-based French pastries, “pastrami” sammies, Thai “chicken” wings, and unbelievable “carne” asada.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: Welcome to the magical world of dessert making. In a homage to the art of conjuring and illusion, our competitors must create magical desserts that melt, crack and lift away, to reveal an inner delight.

programme.sub-title: Crab Bolognese, Crunchy Fennel Salad / Mexican BLT, Chillies, Guacamole and Salad

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Jenn visits an organic grain farmer, a baker, and a whiskey maker to learn about the various uses of wheat.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Waffles are definitely a part of a baker’s repertoire and that woven waffles shape is now known the world around. Here we explore North American, Italian & Belgian styles of waffles.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: A modern approach to a traditional Chinese crowd-pleaser has the Chefs intrigued, and the home cooks get salty when Herbes Salées is revealed in Chef Marysol Foucault’s Quebecois fridge.

programme.desc: Jamie’s cooking up sesame seared tuna, a mouthwatering meal in minutes, and messy meatball buns—feel-good family food that’s fast and loaded with flavor—followed by his irresistibly gooey Chocolate Rye Cookies, home baking at breakneck speed.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: Family recipes are an eternal source of happiness for Italians, and in this episode Silvia shares her family’s - most cherished meals. A rich sausage stew on a bed of soft polenta. programme.title: Feast By Fire
programme.desc: In San Antonio, Jess makes her first visit to Reese Bros BBQ to try their indulgent queso fundido sausage. Bringing it back to her own grill, she shows viewers how to reimagine the gooey, smoky dish at home, with an easy, shareable dish packed with bold Texas flavour.

programme.title: Feast By Fire
programme.desc: At Helberg Barbecue in Waco, Jess discovers the magic of smoke-fried chicken, where low-and-slow meets hot oil for maximum flavour and crunch. Back home, she demystifies the process, showing how to achieve that signature smoky, crispy finish without complicated equipment.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - Cedros Island Adventure, Part Two

Coming out of the gates, the Yellowtail were hungry and wanted to eat everything. This week Shea McIntee and some of the crew decided to mix it up and drive to another local island called Isla de San Benito, about two hours away, to see what it's all about.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.

programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.sub-title: Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. programme.desc: A teacher, a hero, an ex-colonel, and a beautiful woman plan to rob Fort Henderson. Though the heist succeeds, their troubles have only just begun, as greed, betrayal, and danger threaten to unravel their carefully laid plan.

programme.title: Los cuatro salvajes (1968)
programme.desc: Dos aventureros rescatan a un hombre con un mapa del tesoro tatuado en la espalda. Pero para hallar el botín necesitan un segundo mapa… grabado nada menos que en la espalda de un sheriff. Intriga, acción y codicia se desatan en una carrera frenética por el tesoro perdido.

programme.title: Los Locos del Oro Negro (2022)

programme.title: Keoma (2023)
programme.desc: Un ex pistolero mestizo de la Unión intenta proteger su ciudad natal plagada de plagas para que no sea anulada por sus medio hermanos racistas y un tirano confederado.

programme.title: La ley del juez Thorne (1955)
programme.desc: El juez Rick Thorne llega a un pueblo dominado por el poderoso Josiah Bannerman y encarcela a su hijo por asesinato. Sin aliados, debe llevarlo a otra ciudad para un juicio justo. Perseguido por los hombres de Bannerman, lucha contra el poder y la corrupción, mientras Amy Lee, sobrina del magnate, debe decidir de qué lado está la verdad.

programme.title: Un dólar para Sartana (2024)
programme.desc: El único superviviente, llamado Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), de una matanza en el Norte busca venganza. Tras sufrir la atrocidad, Kid ejecuta una venganza en solitario, arrasa, golpea y mata a cada uno de los implicados en la masacre.

programme.title: Buen funeral, amigos... paga Sartana (2023)
programme.desc: Después de ser testigo de una brutal masacre, el legendario héroe Sartana está listo para investigar. Casi todo el mundo en el pequeño pueblo de Indian Creek parece ansioso por comprar la propiedad dejada por las víctimas del asesinato, ...

programme.title: Cjamango - El Vengador (2023)
programme.desc: Justo cuando Cjamango ha ganado una bolsa de oro en una partida de póquer, es atacado por las bandas de El Tigre y Don Pablo.

programme.title: El maquinista de La General (2022)

programme.title: Cuatro balazos (2022)
programme.desc: Un hombre busca venganza por la muerte de su hermana, que mató a su propio amante.

programme.title: La ruta de Denver (2023)
programme.desc: Dos hermanos tejanos fugitivos y enfrentados entre sí huyen a Colorado, donde aceptan trabajos con jefes rivales.

programme.title: Uno más al infierno (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny King, un vagabundo rebelde, se propone vengar la muerte de su mentor y amigo, Steve, después de haber sido asesinado por su tierra por los Hermanos Ward.

programme.title: Los ángeles vengadores (1995)
programme.desc: Miles Utley, un guardaespaldas mormón, se ve forzado a cuestionar sus creencias cuando investiga un caso de asesinato y corrupción inmobiliaria. Su búsqueda de la verdad lo empuja a romper con su comunidad y a enfrentarse a oscuros secretos.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, juicio de fuego (2024)

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 204
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 205
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 206
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 207
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 208
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 201
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 202
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Todo queda en familia; Herencia mía, deuda tuya
programme.desc: Nachi y Enrique son hermanos, conviven con una mujer y los dos están enamorados de ella. Javier exige que Carmen, la pareja de su padre, pague la deuda que dejó su progenitor antes de morir.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana pagó 100 000 dólares por el rescate de Daniela, pero está convencida de que su hermana planificó el secuestro para estafarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ahora mujer para pastora; ¿Se valida el pre-nup o el testamento?
programme.desc: Natasha exige la custodia de su hijo, Brend alega que la ama y que quiere seguir con ella. Un difunto le dejó la herencia a su exmujer, pero su actual esposa tiene un poder para quedarse con todo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Quiero volver a Venezuela; Renuncio a la herencia
programme.desc: Stephanie vino a vivir con su padre y quiere regresar a Venezuela porque él es alcohólico, vive en un tráiler y no se ocupa de ella. Además, tres hermanos se pelean por la herencia de su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joaquín se lesionó cuando jugaba en el equipo de fútbol de su empresa. El dueño se niega a pagarle el sueldo mientras se recupera. José exige que el padre de su nieto se haga cargo del menor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Empresario en bancarrota; Disciplinando a su hija
programme.desc: Claudia recibió una golpiza de una mujer que contrató Ignacio y exige que él le pague 200 000 dólares por daños y perjuicios. Una adolescente rebelde no quiere más castigos corporales de su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mi rival es una perra; Papá por favor quiéreme
programme.desc: Liliana tiene un problema grave: su marido prefiere a su perra, hasta en la cama. Jean es un adolescente desesperado, su padre alcohólico lo desprecia, su única posibilidad es un tío tiránico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amante venérea; Roomate seduce por dinero
programme.desc: Luis tuvo una relación extramatrimonial y fue contagiado con una enfermedad venérea que le causó el divorcio. Lilian renta un cuarto a jóvenes, los seduce y los acusa de intento de violación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Nalga ponchada; El travesti es la mamá
programme.desc: Sara es modelo profesional y durante una sesión de fotos le destrozaron una nalga con un palo de golf. Vanessa es una travesti que se ha encariñado con un niño y ahora no lo quiere entregar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Obligada a hacer peli porno; Enamorado de un diabético
programme.desc: Una madre busca obligar a su hija a que filme películas pornográficas con ella. Un joven diabético está enamorado de una chica menor de edad, ella quiere casarse con él, pero su madre lo prohíbe.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Enamorado de la muerta; La magia del adiós
programme.desc: Un viudo se excita con las cenizas de su difunta esposa para tener relaciones sexuales con su actual mujer. Victoria exige el divorcio a Roberto, quien es mago y desaparece el dinero que gana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Papá que muera en la calle
programme.desc: Un padre vagabundo está muriendo de cáncer y quiere regresar a su hogar. Sus hijos están divididos entre los que quieren recibirlo y los que no.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Custodia de niña para Caso Cerrado; Pintor incestuoso
programme.desc: Gustavo exige que Sandra desaloje a su sobrina de dos años de su casa, pero ella se rehúsa. Un joven pintor dice que su hermana y su madre se desnudan y se acuestan con él para calmar su ansiedad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sebas muerto, 2 hermanas, bebé y novio; Me gustan mordidas
programme.desc: Juan exige una orden de desalojo para Ana Laura, la ex amante de su hermano fallecido. Ella se quedó en su casa, pero él alega que no tiene derecho. Un joven muerde al tener relaciones íntimas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una madre incita a su hija y a su prima a que se besen en la boca y sube las fotos a Internet. Una adolescente embarazada se refugia en la casa de su novio, los padres de ambos buscan una solución.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Fotos por debajo de la falda; Esposo no quiere esposa incompetente
programme.desc: Salvador es artista y se dedica a sacar fotos por debajo de las faldas de mujeres, lo cual es legal en Texas. Julio le exige a Lisa que reciba a su madre en casa y ella dice que necesita tiempo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hermanastra quiere cenizas de papá; Semen para depresión
programme.desc: Adriana y su hermanastra pelean por las cenizas de su padre. Una era la preferida, la otra se sintió discriminada. Alejandra descubrió que el semen de su marido es su remedio para la depresión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Padre y depredador; De largo orgasmo
programme.desc: Camilo exige la custodia de los hijos de su hermana fallecida porque el padre de los niños es un depredador sexual. En otro caso, los orgasmos de mujer son tan prolongados que la despidieron de películas porno.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lina pide la custodia de su hermanita de 16 años, su hermana mayor permite que se prostituya. Lourdes exige una orden de alejamiento para Néstor, no soporta su acoso; él la trata como una prisionera.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Esposo que pone cuernos con suegra; Pene torcido
programme.desc: Saaid exige la custodia total del hijo que tiene con Sofía. Él se acostó con su suegra y su esposa se niega a perdonarlo. Karen le torció el pene a su amante cuando practicaban sexo oral.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carolina asegura que su hija seduce a su esposo Santiago, exige el desalojo de la joven. Con el dinero ganado en un torneo porno, Susana desea curarle a Rodrigo su problema de falta de orgasmos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alba no desea divorciarse de Eliana, quiere ir a terapia. Mónica y su marido contrataron a Kathy como madre subrogada a cambio de 25 mil dólares. Kathy tuvo gemelos, pero la pareja solo quiere un bebé.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cáncer de testículos; Técnica de publicidad gay
programme.desc: Christopher tiene cáncer de testículos y quiere que su madre le entregue su esperma a su novia. Micaela exige disolver la sociedad con Alex y busca atraer a parejas homosexuales al restaurante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Priapismo femenino; Tías se pelean custodia de sobrino
programme.desc: Jorgelina desea dejar el tratamiento que excita su clítoris y le causa dolor. Su esposo Juan la demanda. Tías se disputan la custodia del sobrino que padece hiperactividad y trastornos psicológicos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: No soy lesbiana; Separada por una deportación
programme.desc: Julieta quiere el divorcio y una compensación porque Betiana la convirtió en lesbiana. Mauricio y Johana fueron deportados a diferentes países. Él quiere quedarse con los dos hijos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sandra le prestó ocho mil dólares a su hija para casarse, pero como la joven es lesbiana, Sandra le pide el dinero de vuelta. La esposa de Ángel quedó embarazada tras una violación y quiere abortar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La Elizabeth Taylor mexicana; Hijo muerto en hospital mex
programme.desc: Mónica es adicta a tener maridos, su actual esposo la demanda por dos mil dólares mensuales. Karim le pide dinero a su esposo para ir a México a demandar al hospital que mató a su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amante estafador; No hay nada en común
programme.desc: Patricia le dio estabilidad económica, él le correspondió con engaños, infidelidades y estafas. Omar no quiere mantener a su esposa, descubrió que le ha sido infiel durante todo el matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Rosa descubre a su hija desnuda teniendo sexo virtual con un chico. Además, Jorge nació en EE. UU., pero su mamá tuvo otro hijo en México, a quien trajo con sus documentos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Dalvio y Víctor se enfrentan con armas. Cansado, Dalvio enfrenta a Aurelio y se amenazan con pistolas. Colón traslada a Esperanza como testigo protegido a una casa de seguridad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rafael le ofrece "merca" a Mónica a cambio de información sobre Casillas y ella saca las garras. Extraditan a Felina. Aurelio va tras Emiliana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas está de cacería tras Emiliana. Amenaza con comérsela viva. Investigan el pasado de Rutila y aunque niega todo, cuando Castillo se va, ella se quiebra. Él está muy cerca de la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se abre camino en México para hacer negocios a lo grande. El presidente la espera en Toluca y allí ventilan el pasado. Salazar desenreda el negocio de las metanfetaminas.

programme.desc: Phoenix, Arizona wasn't supposed to be the city we know in present day. Before Area 51, hidden deep in the desert, the military discovered a hidden gem that helped them cover up the UFO wave of 1947. Roswell was not the only event that took place. programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: A young man disappears in the Midwest. As detectives struggle to find leads, a desperate father turns to psychics Nita Lee and Dr. Sally Headding. Both see three men hired for a horrific killing. To help police, Sally takes detectives on a psychic odyssey, retracing the missing man's last day. A family in Pennsylvania calls the police to check on their reclusive father. Worry turns to grief when officers discover he's been murdered. Across town, psychic Jan Helen McGee awakens from a frightening dream. But it's no nightmare - she's witnessed the murder and now must help police find the killer.

programme.desc: Benjamín es extraditado tras las amenazas de muerte hacia Ricardo. Elizabeth, sumida en el dolor por la muerte de Celia, decide mudarse con su padre pese a la presencia de Katiuska, pero sufre una preocupante hemorragia nasal. Por otro lado, María del Pilar asegura que su hijo es de Marcelo ante la presión de Gustavo. Mientras Marcelo busca el divorcio de Graciela, Misael continúa profesando su amor por Manuela en medio de tensiones familiares y planes de venganza.

programme.title: Episodio 99 (2026)
programme.desc: Los delincuentes liberan a Leticia tras el secuestro. Eustoquio se roba los documentos del Hato de Perijá del despacho de Rivero. Adolfo botará a Vilma de la empresa al descubrir que ordenó el secuestro. Erasto humilla a Natalia, ya completamente borracho, obligándola a desnudarse y bailar, y le habla a Natalia como si fuera Consuelo, revelando su obsesión. Eustoquio visita a Consuelo exigiendo su parte de la herencia como hijo de Erasto. Marisela bebe con Isaías. Alejandro sorprende a Rosa al regresar y le confiesa todo su amor.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Gina provoca a Clemencia para que le diga la verdad sobre Luis Francisco Vilarte, acusándola de que eran amantes. Le pregunta sobre las cartas que guardaba de él, pero Clemencia no le dice nada, en cambio la golpea y Gina reacciona fuerte contra ella. Más tarde, Gina le cuenta a su padre Augusto sobre esto, y lo intenta hacer recapacitar sobre la infidelidad de Clemencia. Augusto se niega a escuchar sus palabras y le dice que ella no es lo suficientemente madura como para esos temas.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal se reconcilia con Ana y ponen otra vez fecha de boda. Carlota va a visitar a Conrado y de paso le da una mano a Mireya con el aseo personal del enfermo. Pedrote llama a Patricia para que presencie en vivo y en directo como atrapan a unos ladrones en la joyería del centro comercial. Es allí donde se cruzan María José y Venancio por primera vez y ella queda impactada por el comisario. Purita ayuda a su madre en la limpieza del condominio pero se viste muy sexy y es regañada por su madre para que sea más discreta con la ropa que usa.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián está viendo por la ventana las escenas de amor de Armando y Finita. Se va pero se siente mal y Blanca sale a auxiliarlo Botero se siente mal | no habla. Blanca trata de ayudarlo pero al final lo deja irse Finita trata de convencer a Armando de que no se vaya pero el no se deja convencer y se va. Carolina va donde Juan Diego y comienza a perseguirlo para besarlo. Llega Yubiri y el le tapa la boca a Carolina y la esconde. Cuando se va Yubiri Carolina lo insulta.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: El doctor llama a Magdalena y le confirma que la junta consultiva ha decidido entregarle la información que ella pidió. Gabriel le ofrece acompañarla a buscar el sobre. Cuando llegan a la clínica, el doctor plantea que hay un inconveniente, y Agustín aparece, para explicar que a él no le habían pedido su permiso, como padre legal de Rodrigo. El doctor resuelve en dejar que Agustín decida si se abre el sobre o no, y él no deja que Magdalena sepa la verdad. - Ella se va triste, junto a Gabriel, y él la consuela. Epi se infiltra en la casa de Julieta vestido de mujer, haciéndose pasar por amiga de Ana Belén. Allí logra conseguir un cuaderno de Julieta, y luego se da a la fuga, dejando inclusive un zapato, el que luego Ana Belén sospecha que es de Valentina.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es extraditado tras las amenazas de muerte hacia Ricardo. Elizabeth, sumida en el dolor por la muerte de Celia, decide mudarse con su padre pese a la presencia de Katiuska, pero sufre una preocupante hemorragia nasal. Por otro lado, María del Pilar asegura que su hijo es de Marcelo ante la presión de Gustavo. Mientras Marcelo busca el divorcio de Graciela, Misael continúa profesando su amor por Manuela en medio de tensiones familiares y planes de venganza.

programme.title: Episodio 99 (2026)
programme.desc: Los delincuentes liberan a Leticia tras el secuestro. Eustoquio se roba los documentos del Hato de Perijá del despacho de Rivero. Adolfo botará a Vilma de la empresa al descubrir que ordenó el secuestro. Erasto humilla a Natalia, ya completamente borracho, obligándola a desnudarse y bailar, y le habla a Natalia como si fuera Consuelo, revelando su obsesión. Eustoquio visita a Consuelo exigiendo su parte de la herencia como hijo de Erasto. Marisela bebe con Isaías. Alejandro sorprende a Rosa al regresar y le confiesa todo su amor.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Amada le pide a Germán que mate a Enzo y a Milagros. Germán acepta y va a comentarle a Willy, pero él no acepta la idea de matar a nadie. Eulalia los encuentra y le pregunta a Germán por los teléfonos. Él le miente diciéndole que los tenía porque los estaba arreglando, pero Eulalia no le cree. German se va con Willy y Eulalia los sigue con un taxi. Luego Germán lo intenta convencer de nuevo, pero Willy no acepta y Germán le dice que se retire porque él sí va a cometer el crimen.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo y Ana deciden, a pesar de ellos, ser amigos para no interferir en la relación de ella con Cristóbal. Venancio le tiene que pedir disculpas a Pedro (Onofre) por acusarlo de la muerte de Diego ya que el comisario no tiene pruebas suficientes. Esto gratifica a Pedro pero al leer un primera plana que acusan al fantasma de la muerte del envenenado del rio, lo enfurece y promete matar a Barrranco por publicarlo, a Clarita y a Patricia por escribir esa nota. A su vez esa nota enorgullece a Nancy porque la escribió su hija, pero esto le trae problemas a Patricia con Pedrote porque él le dio esa información

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián no le habla a Finita | solamente la ve. Ella trata de inventar cosas pero el no le habla. Le pasa una libreta y un lápiz para que escriba | el escribe y se levanta y se va. Ella lee y se horroriza con lo que le escribió pero le da la razón. En la casa de Atanasio están despidiendo con una cena a Armando por su viaje. En casa de Briggite están hablando de Finita y los cuernos que le montó a Botero. Briggite y Dionisia están de acuerdo pero Carolina no.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena y Gabriel se besan. Están enamorados. Ella no quiere hacerle pasar un mal momento a su hijo. Gabriel está dispuesto a divorciarse de Angie y se lo cuenta a su madre. Valentina sorprende a Epi vestido de mujer y le cuenta a Gloria la historia de la niña que llevó en su vientre. Seis Nueve le confiesa a Julieta que cada vez se siente más atraído hacia ella. Julieta llama a sus padres, pero solo los escucha y no contesta. Zuleica le hace saber a Julieta que Seis Nueve es suyo y está decide irse del barrio. Ana Belén no entiende la actitud pasiva de su esposo con Valentina. Efraín no se anima a confesarle a su mujer, que está enamorado y que quiere dejarla. Deibis está muy desconforme con que Gabriel sea su tío. Toño le confiesa que a él tampoco le cae bien.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo regresa a la casa Tariffi, rompe con Katiuska y reafirma su amor por Manuela. Mientras Katiuska conspira contra los hijos de Ricardo y busca ayuda de criminales, Gustavo es hospitalizado por su grave estado de intoxicación. Marcelo es engañado por María del Pilar sobre un falso embarazo y Elizabeth oculta síntomas de una enfermedad. Finalmente, Ricardo lee una emotiva carta de Celia que lo insta a cuidar de sus hijos y a unirse definitivamente con Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro abraza a Rosa confesándole su amor, mientras Rosalía los espia y jura vengarse. Adolfo despide oficialmente a Vilma frente a Salvador. Eustoquio cuenta a Arminda haber robado los documentos. Rivero descubre el robo y avisa a Erasto, quien acusa a Alejandro inmediatamente. Marisela se desahoga con Rosa confesándole su soledad. Consuelo y Blanca planifican estrategias contra Erasto. Carmen Rosa le pide a Rosa devolver la hacienda. Natalia advierte a Alejandro que Erasto lo acusó del robo. Erasto entra furioso en la oficina de Adolfo buscando a Alejandro.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. programme.title: Jaque Mate (2012)
programme.desc: David Hernández, conocido por ser el presentador del exitoso programa ficticio de juegos "Jaque Mate", se ve repentinamente sumergido en una pesadilla cuando recibe una llamada anónima durante una transmisión en vivo. El desconocido le informa que su hijo y esposa han sido secuestrados y que su vida depende de seguir las instrucciones que le dará en el programa. Aterrorizado y bajo la presión del secuestrador, David se ve obligado a convertir su programa en un escenario para cumplir con las demandas del criminal. Mientras la audiencia mira atónita, David debe resolver acertijos y desafíos en tiempo real para garantizar la seguridad de su familia. La tensión aumenta a medida que cada movimiento en el juego televisivo podría significar la diferencia entre la vida y la muerte para sus seres queridos. Determinado y enfrentando peligros desconocidos, David se embarca en una incansable búsqueda para reunir a su familia sana y salva, desafiando todo lo que le rodea para lograr su objetivo.

programme.title: Doppelganger (1993)
programme.desc: A young woman flees New York City after being implicated in a murder and moves to Los Angeles, where she rents a room from a writer. They begin an affair, but it seems she's been followed by a homicidal duplicate of herself.

programme.title: Prehysteria 2 (1994)
programme.desc: Miniature dinosaurs help a boy outwit a malevolent governess who wants to pack him off to a military boarding school.

programme.title: Basquiat (1996)
programme.desc: Self-destructiveness and disdain for the middle class mark the life of artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, dead of an overdose in 1988.

programme.title: A Midnight Clear (1992)
programme.desc: A young GI (Ethan Hawke) and his squad have a strange encounter with Germans in the Ardennes forest, December 1944.

programme.title: Clockwatchers (1997)
programme.desc: Friendship helps make nightmarish office jobs bearable for four young women working as temporary employees.

programme.title: Wild Side (1995)
programme.desc: A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael (1990)
programme.desc: An offbeat Ohio teenager (Winona Ryder) eagerly awaits the return of a legendary wild one she figures is her mother.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch (1996)
programme.desc: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

programme.title: Point Break (1991)
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

programme.title: Bloodfist VIII: Hard Way Out (1996)
programme.desc: A teen (John Patrick White) learns his nerdy math-teacher father (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) is an ex-CIA operative hunted by assassins.

programme.title: Funny Games (1997)
programme.desc: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

programme.title: Manos, the Hands of Fate (1966)
programme.desc: While on a desert excursion, a family encounters cultists who use human hands as sacrificial offerings to their god.

programme.title: Fever Pitch (1997)
programme.desc: A teacher (Colin Firth), obsessed with soccer and a team that hasn't won a league cup in 18 years, begins a shaky relationship.

programme.title: Stunt Squad (2025)
programme.desc: In the city of Bologna, the dangerous bandit Valli, with his group, runs an extortion racket by terrorizing merchants. On the gang's trail comes Police Commissioner Grifi, kicking off a long hunt for the extortionists and murderers.

programme.title: Ready to fight (2025)
programme.desc: Deceit, betrayal, and treachery unfold in the dangerous underworld of currency smugglers.

programme.title: Super Fuzz (2024)
programme.desc: Policeman Dave Speed is not like any other policeman: as a result of an atomic explosion he acquired superpowers, which he uses to fight crime. However, his super strength has limits: the colour red nullifies his extraordinary abilities...

programme.title: The Day of the Owl (2025)
programme.desc: Italian film classic directed by Damiano Damiani. In a small town in Sicily, Captain Bellodi must investigate the murder of an entrepreneur. A police informant puts him on the right track, but once the investigation begins, the captain will encounter serious difficulties. Starring the great Claudia Cardinale and the legendary Franco Nero.

programme.title: Creeping Death (2026)
programme.desc: Undercover agent Alan Fields hunts a rogue thief who killed his partners to keep the stolen loot.

programme.title: Bang bank (2026)
programme.desc: A botched bank robbery forces a clumsy thief to team up with his hostages to plan a desperate escape.

programme.title: Stunt Squad (2025)
programme.desc: In the city of Bologna, the dangerous bandit Valli, with his group, runs an extortion racket by terrorizing merchants. On the gang's trail comes Police Commissioner Grifi, kicking off a long hunt for the extortionists and murderers.

programme.title: Ready to fight (2025)
programme.desc: Deceit, betrayal, and treachery unfold in the dangerous underworld of currency smugglers.

programme.title: Murder Obsession (2025)
programme.desc: Michael Stanford, a promising young actor, suffers from the stress caused by his job. Fatigue creates large gaps in his memory and makes him unstable character-wise. Therefore, Michael decides to retreat to his mother's house, inviting the entire film crew as well.

programme.title: La moglie in vacanza l'amante in città (2025)
programme.desc: A comedic drama about a man who navigates a love triangle while his wife is away on vacation.

programme.title: Garter Colt (2026)

programme.title: The Aztecs (2025)
programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.

programme.title: The Incas (2025)
programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.

programme.title: First Before Columbus (2025)
programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun (2025)
programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.title: The East (2025)
programme.desc: After the war, hunger and adversity shape daily life in East Germany. Many Berliners go to the countryside in search of food. In the city, a notorious gang of youths is up to no good.

programme.title: The West (2025)
programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.

programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany (2025)
programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: The D-Days Spies (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how agents tricked the Germans to keep their troops out of Normandy.

programme.title: The Soldier who never was (2025)
programme.desc: Discover a darkly humorous British ploy that helped the 1943 landing in Sicily.

programme.title: The Spy who Saved the World (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.

programme.title: The A-Bomb Spies (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: The Rise of Judea (2025)
programme.desc: The Rise of Judea explores the tumultuous reign of King Herod and the ascent of Roman stewardship in Judea through the words of Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: The Fall of Judea (2025)
programme.desc: The Fatal Conflict Episode 2 explores the events that shaped the great Jewish revolt against Rome, as recorded by Jewish General, historian and perceived traitor, Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: A business empire (2025)

programme.title: The fall of the order (2025)
programme.desc: At the end of the 13th century, as Christian holdings in the holy land have disappeared, the Templars continue to push for a new crusade.

programme.title: The Miracles of Jesus (2025)
programme.desc: For more than 2000 years, he has been the most discussed character in History. What do we really know about Jesus today?

programme.title: The Quest for the Ark of the Covenant (2025)
programme.desc: In Judaism, it’s the most sacred object. A chest carved in acacia wood, gilded with gold leaf, and topped by two cherubs. The Ark of the Covenant strikes down the Mortal who touches it.

programme.title: The Quest for the Grail (2025)
programme.desc: It’s the most desired and sacred relic in Christianity. However, this artefact is shrouded in mystery. No one can say what it looks like. Today, dozens of churches claim to hold the Grail.
